name: integer_parity
description: Few-shot integer parity classification on one- and two-digit integers, with matched number-copy controls.
generator_code:
import random,json
random.seed(0)
items=[];control=[]
for i in range(80):
 n=random.randrange(1,81)
 items.append({'prompt':f'Classify as even or odd.
2: even
3: odd
8: even
11: odd
{n}:','answer':' '+('even' if n%2==0 else 'odd')})
 control.append({'prompt':f'Copy the number.
2: 2
3: 3
8: 8
11: 11
{n}:','answer':' '+str(n)})
json.dump({'items':items,'control':control},open('/work/skill.json','w'))
